generationInputs.prompt: A digitally drawn illustration in a clean, graphic, and expressive modern emoji style shows two happy, thin yellow emojis with bold black outlines and flat, vibrant color fills. Both emojis are wearing black-framed glasses. One emoji is standing behind the other emoji which is lying on its stomach on a platform. Both emojis have a round head with two large, expressive brown eyes with white highlights and black pupils. The standing emoji has eyes looking forward, and the emoji lying on its stomach has the back of its head visible. The standing emoji has thin, curved black eyebrows raised in a happy expression and a wide, curved black line indicating a smile. The standing emoji has two thin arms bent upwards with closed, clenched fists, and the emoji lying on its stomach has two thin arms extended outwards with open hands holding onto ropes attached to the platform. Below the torso, the standing emoji has two thin legs with feet pointing outwards. Very thin black thong bottoms with bold black outlines are worn low on each emoji's body. The emoji lying on its stomach has a visible thinner waist and back and is lying on a simple, flat platform. Above, several white clouds and lightning bolts are depicted, and diamond shapes are falling as if rain, transitioning from white at the top to black at the bottom. There is subtle shading suggesting a surface below the standing emoji. The background is a blurry black with purple lights.
